SELECT 
  'Starting DWH Load' as status,
  NOW() as start_time,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_transactions WHERE data_quality_flag = 'VALID') as staging_records

-- Step 1: Load Date Dimension from staging
INSERT INTO dim_date (
  date_key, date, year, quarter, month, month_name, week, day, 
  day_of_week, day_name, is_weekend, is_month_start, is_month_end
)
WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
  SELECT DATE(MIN(InvoiceDate)) as date FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  FROM date_range
  WHERE date < (SELECT DATE(MAX(InvoiceDate)) FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions)
)
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y%m%d') as date_key,
  date,
  YEAR(date) as year,
  QUARTER(date) as quarter,
  MONTH(date) as month,
  DATE_FORMAT(date, '%M') as month_name,
  WEEK(date) as week,
  DAY(date) as day,
  DAYOFWEEK(date) as day_of_week,
  DATE_FORMAT(date, '%W') as day_name,
  CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(date) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_weekend,
  CASE WHEN DAY(date) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_month_start,
  CASE WHEN DAY(date) = DAY(LAST_DAY(date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_month_end
FROM date_range
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE year = VALUES(year)

-- Step 2: Load Products from staging
INSERT INTO dim_products (
  StockCode, Description, avg_unit_price, first_sold_date, 
  last_sold_date, total_quantity_sold, is_active
)
SELECT 
  StockCode,
  MAX(Description) as Description,
  ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) as avg_unit_price,
  MIN(DATE(InvoiceDate)) as first_sold_date,
  MAX(DATE(InvoiceDate)) as last_sold_date,
  SUM(Quantity) as total_quantity_sold,
  1 as is_active
FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions
WHERE data_quality_flag = 'VALID'
GROUP BY StockCode
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  Description = VALUES(Description),
  avg_unit_price = VALUES(avg_unit_price),
  last_sold_date = GREATEST(last_sold_date, VALUES(last_sold_date)),
  total_quantity_sold = total_quantity_sold + VALUES(total_quantity_sold),
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

-- Step 3: Load Customers from staging with Segmentation
INSERT INTO dim_customers (
  CustomerID, Country, first_purchase_date, last_purchase_date,
  total_orders, total_spent, customer_segment, is_active
)
SELECT 
  CustomerID,
  MAX(Country) as Country,
  MIN(DATE(InvoiceDate)) as first_purchase_date,
  MAX(DATE(InvoiceDate)) as last_purchase_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) as total_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount), 2) as total_spent,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(TotalAmount) >= 10000 THEN 'VIP'
    WHEN SUM(TotalAmount) >= 5000 THEN 'High Value'
    WHEN SUM(TotalAmount) >= 1000 THEN 'Medium Value'
    ELSE 'Low Value'
  END as customer_segment,
  1 as is_active
FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions
WHERE has_valid_customer = 1 AND data_quality_flag = 'VALID'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  Country = VALUES(Country),
  last_purchase_date = GREATEST(last_purchase_date, VALUES(last_purchase_date)),
  total_orders = total_orders + VALUES(total_orders),
  total_spent = total_spent + VALUES(total_spent),
  customer_segment = CASE 
    WHEN total_spent + VALUES(total_spent) >= 10000 THEN 'VIP'
    WHEN total_spent + VALUES(total_spent) >= 5000 THEN 'High Value'
    WHEN total_spent + VALUES(total_spent) >= 1000 THEN 'Medium Value'
    ELSE 'Low Value'
  END,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

-- Step 4: Load Fact Sales from staging
INSERT INTO fact_sales (
  date_key, customer_key, product_key, InvoiceNo, Quantity,
  UnitPrice, TotalAmount, Country, is_cancelled, is_return, transaction_hour
)
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(s.InvoiceDate, '%Y%m%d') as date_key,
  c.customer_key,
  p.product_key,
  s.InvoiceNo,
  s.Quantity,
  s.UnitPrice,
  s.TotalAmount,
  s.Country,
  s.is_cancelled,
  s.is_return,
  HOUR(s.InvoiceDate) as transaction_hour
FROM ecommerce_staging.stg_transactions s
INNER JOIN ecommerce_dwh.dim_products p ON s.StockCode = p.StockCode
LEFT JOIN ecommerce_dwh.dim_customers c ON s.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE s.data_quality_flag = 'VALID'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ecommerce_dwh.fact_sales f
    WHERE f.InvoiceNo = s.InvoiceNo
      AND f.product_key = p.product_key
      AND f.date_key = DATE_FORMAT(s.InvoiceDate, '%Y%m%d')
      AND ABS(f.TotalAmount - s.TotalAmount) < 0.01
  )

SELECT 
  'Load Complete' as status,
  NOW() as end_time,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_date) as total_dates,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_products) as total_products,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_customers) as total_customers,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales) as total_sales,
  (SELECT ROUND(SUM(TotalAmount), 2) FROM fact_sales) as total_revenue
